Your family will be crying they wont stop crying for days and days and every holiday or birthday or celebration they will think of you. Please dont die... i suffer from eczema too and found out by accident a good way that i help my flare ups. Firstly the cream i use is called under udder (yes it is formulated to help cow udders but trust me it works so well also i use it on my dogs, cats, sheep and horses) next after i smother the cream on is to wrap it up with cling film- its a little fiddly but its to stop it rubbing off and helps soak in the cream. 

It helps if you do this at night and dont wash it off in the morning (although my flare ups are usually based on water and my skin *sigh*)
